outputs.summarizer: The response received depends on the specific subject in question. For Cyndi Lauper's debut album *She's So Unusual*, it received positive reviews from music critics upon its release, was selected for preservation in the United States National Recording Registry in 2019, and ranked 494th among Rolling Stone's 500 Greatest Albums of All Time. For the film *Kinky Boots*, it received mixed reviews from critics, with some decried the "formulaic Britcom plot," though it was based on 112 reviews from Rotten Tomatoes. The musical version of *Kinky Boots* was initially less well received by theatre critics and at the box office compared to *Matilda the Musical*. Cyndi Lauper herself received recording offers as a solo artist. Without a specific subject identified in the question, the exact response cannot be pinpointed, but these examples illustrate the varied responses received by different entities mentioned in the evidence.

task_results.question: what can you tell me about the songwriter?
task_results.prediction: Based on the provided evidence, the songwriter is **Cyndi Lauper** (also known as Cynthia Ann Stephanie Lauper), an American singer, songwriter, and actress. She is recognized as one of the few singers to win three of the four major American entertainment awards (EGOT) and was inducted into both the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame (November 2025) and the Songwriters Hall of Fame (2015). Lauper earned two Grammy Awards at the 27th Annual Grammy Awards and received a Grammy Award for Best Musical Theater Album in 2014 for her work on *Kinky Boots*, for which she was the first woman to win the Tony Award for Best Original Score by herself. The musical *Kinky Boots* also won Best Musical and five other Tonys, as well as three Laurence Olivier Awards in 2016. Her music has been influenced by synth-pop and pop rock, and she has received nominations for "Time After Time" for Song of the Year at the Grammys. Additionally, her song "Girls Just Want to Have Fun" won Best Female Video at the 1984 MTV Video Music Awards and was nominated for Best Female Pop Vocal Performance and Record of the Year at the 1985 Grammy Awards. Lauper also spent time working in retail stores and waitressing at IHOP due to financial problems before achieving success.

Her music has been influenced by synth-pop and pop rock, and she has received nominations for "Time After Time" for Song of the Year at the Grammys. Additionally, her song "Girls Just Want to Have Fun" won Best Female Video at the 1984 MTV Video Music Awards and was nominated for Best Female Pop Vocal Performance and Record of the Year at the 1985 Grammy Awards. Lauper also spent time working in retail stores and waitressing at IHOP due to financial problems before achieving success.

outputs.summarizer: Based on the provided evidence, the songwriter is **Cyndi Lauper** (also known as Cynthia Ann Stephanie Lauper), an American singer, songwriter, and actress. She is recognized as one of the few singers to win three of the four major American entertainment awards (EGOT) and was inducted into both the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame (November 2025) and the Songwriters Hall of Fame (2015). Lauper earned two Grammy Awards at the 27th Annual Grammy Awards and received a Grammy Award for Best Musical Theater Album in 2014 for her work on *Kinky Boots*, for which she was the first woman to win the Tony Award for Best Original Score by herself. The musical *Kinky Boots* also won Best Musical and five other Tonys, as well as three Laurence Olivier Awards in 2016. Her music has been influenced by synth-pop and pop rock, and she has received nominations for "Time After Time" for Song of the Year at the Grammys. Additionally, her song "Girls Just Want to Have Fun" won Best Female Video at the 1984 MTV Video Music Awards and was nominated for Best Female Pop Vocal Performance and Record of the Year at the 1985 Grammy Awards. Lauper also spent time working in retail stores and waitressing at IHOP due to financial problems before achieving success.

task_results.final_answer: Based on the provided evidence, the songwriter is **Cyndi Lauper** (also known as Cynthia Ann Stephanie Lauper), an American singer, songwriter, and actress. She is recognized as one of the few singers to win three of the four major American entertainment awards (EGOT) and was inducted into both the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame (November 2025) and the Songwriters Hall of Fame (2015). Lauper earned two Grammy Awards at the 27th Annual Grammy Awards and received a Grammy Award for Best Musical Theater Album in 2014 for her work on *Kinky Boots*, for which she was the first woman to win the Tony Award for Best Original Score by herself. The musical *Kinky Boots* also won Best Musical and five other Tonys, as well as three Laurence Olivier Awards in 2016. Her music has been influenced by synth-pop and pop rock, and she has received nominations for "Time After Time" for Song of the Year at the Grammys. Additionally, her song "Girls Just Want to Have Fun" won Best Female Video at the 1984 MTV Video Music Awards and was nominated for Best Female Pop Vocal Performance and Record of the Year at the 1985 Grammy Awards. Lauper also spent time working in retail stores and waitressing at IHOP due to financial problems before achieving success.
